Apasionado por la convergencia entre backend, cloud computing e IA, buscando siempre liderar proyectos transformadores con alto impacto técnico y social.
aboutEn: Software Development Technologist with more than 4 years of professional experience in Laravel, Node.js, Vue, React, and Cloud and Artificial Intelligence technologies. I transform ideas into scalable digital solutions that drive operational efficiency and innovation. I build optimized web applications, automate processes, and create efficient RESTful APIs to integrate systems and improve user experience. I am passionate about the convergence of backend, cloud computing, and AI, and I am always looking to lead transformative projects with high technical and social impact.
